text:
```yaml
name: Lint Objective-C New Usage

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.m'
      - '**/*.h'

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    name: Check for [new] usage in Objective-C
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@09a7688d3b55cf0e976497ff046b70949eeaccfd # v1.288.0
        with:
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: make init-ci-build

      - name: Check for [new] usage
        run: |
          # Find all occurrences of [ClassName new] pattern in Objective-C files
          NEW_USAGE=$(find . -name "*.m" -o -name "*.h" | xargs grep -n "\[.* new\]" | grep -v "^\./\.git/" | grep -v "^\./Pods/")
          
          if [ -n "$NEW_USAGE" ]; then
            echo "❌ Found [new] usage in Objective-C files:"
            echo "$NEW_USAGE"
            echo ""
            echo "Please replace all [ClassName new] calls with [[ClassName alloc] init] in the files above."
            echo "This is enforced by the convention in AGENTS.md."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ No [new] usage found in Objective-C files."
          fi
```
